result.summary: Found 2 minor to major visual and content issues affecting card display and promo labeling.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is cut off by the navigation bar, hiding its title and metadata.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding to scroll container so content isn't obscured by navigation.

issues.description: Badge displays '-100%' discount, which appears to be placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Update discount badge with realistic promotional percentage or fix backend discount logic.
